AI-GENERATED DRAFT - PENDING HUMAN FACT-CHECK. Not for publication without review.

Research Draft: Claimed Structural Isomorphism Between Neural Networks and the Cosmic Web

Project Parallax — corpus-scale working note (not a final publication)

Purpose and limits of this draft

This draft restates only the supplied Project Parallax dataset on whether published sources can be treated as evidence of a structural isomorphism between neural networks and the cosmic web. The dataset is labeled meta_analysis_illustrative. It is described in the source record as a statistical classification of 35 abstracts by an LLM into the categories supports_veridical, null_result, neuro_mechanism, and inconclusive. The same record states that this is a corpus-scale aggregate, not a single-paper citation, and that it is not a hand-verified systematic review.

The supplied field arxiv_source_found is true. The supplied field boundary_status is CORPUS_ANALYSIS_COMPLETE. No additional counts, percentages, effect sizes, or similarity metrics are introduced beyond those in the dataset.

skeptic_critique Methodological check: This is a statistical aggregate of 35 abstracts classified by an LLM, NOT a hand-verified systematic review. A visual or topological “resemblance” between two networks (neural and cosmic web) reported across the corpus is NOT a causal link and must NOT be presented as a scientific “isomorphism” without a specific quantitative comparison study with a stated metric and citation.

Working reading of the corpus labels

Under the labels provided with this dataset, 35 of 35 classified records are inconclusive for the Project Parallax question. The reported share that supports a veridical reading is 0.0%. The reported shares for null_result and neuro_mechanism are also 0.0%. Those figures are corpus-level tallies of abstract classifications; they are not measurements of network similarity.

Title strings in the citation list include work on neuronal networks, the cosmic web, graph neural networks, connectomes, and related methods. One listed title is “The Quantitative Comparison Between the Neuronal Network and the Cosmic Web” (2020; authors listed as F. Vazza, A. Feletti, Marius Cautun). In the supplied classification field that record is labeled inconclusive, the same label applied to every other listed source. This draft does not extract, restate, or invent quantitative comparison metrics from that paper or from any other paper, because no such metrics are present in the dataset.

Consistent with the supplied skeptic critique, a reported visual or topological resemblance between two networks is not treated here as a causal link and is not presented as a scientific isomorphism. The dataset does not include a stated comparison metric that would support such a claim. Human fact-checking of the LLM abstract labels remains pending.

Draft standing conclusion for Project Parallax

On the supplied illustrative meta-analysis record, the corpus does not currently support treating a structural isomorphism between neural networks and the cosmic web as an established result. The only classification share above zero in the dataset is inconclusive at 100.0% (35 of 35). This draft therefore leaves the isomorphism claim unendorsed pending human review of the underlying papers, the LLM labels, and any quantitative comparison that states an explicit metric and citation.
